history.player: [You went looking for the traveller and have just found them. What brought you: a traveller has just got off the train, and nobody has told them anything about the village yet. Say your opening line.]
history.say: あっ！ 新しい人だ！ どこから来たの？ 名前は？
history.translation: Ah! A new person! Where did you come from? What's your name?
